description: Unit test module for testing Azure OpenAI exception mapping, specifically focusing on handling innererror details within custom exceptions, including various cases such as missing innererror and invalid body formats.

classes.name: TestAzureExceptionMapping
classes.description: Test suite for Azure exception mapping, verifying correct extraction of innererror details and robustness against malformed responses.

methods.name: test_azure_content_policy_violation_innererror_access(self)
methods.description: Verifies that innererror details are correctly extracted and accessible in the custom exception when the exception includes a properly structured body.

methods.name: test_azure_content_policy_violation_different_categories(self)
methods.description: Checks that various content filter categories and their severity/filtered status are correctly reflected in the provider-specific fields.

methods.name: test_azure_content_policy_violation_missing_innererror(self)
methods.description: Ensures that the absence of innererror in the response body results in a proper exception with provider_specific_fields set accordingly.

methods.name: test_azure_content_policy_violation_non_dict_body(self)
methods.description: Tests behavior when the body attribute is not a dictionary, expecting the innererror to be None and exception to be raised appropriately.
